addModeHelp: Click: +1. Right-click: remove the card. Ctrl+drag on already selected cards deselects them, otherwise selects them. The page scrolls at the screen edge. Ctrl+A: select all. Alt+click one card, then click or Alt+click another: selects every number between them, e.g. #001 to #005a without taking #005b.
addModeHelpTouch: Tap a card: +1. Use − and + on the card to adjust the quantity, or “Select all” to take every card shown.
rangeStart: Range start: #{number}. Click the end card.
missingTotalPartial: Total price of missing cards: {total} (excluding {unpriced} without a price)
leaveBody: {count} {noun} have not been added to the collection. Leaving add mode clears this selection.
